goal_text: You lift the lid of the chest. Gold, finally. The cellar has given up its secret.

lantern.name: brass lantern
lantern.description: A brass lantern, still half full of oil.

coin.name: copper coin
coin.description: A dull copper coin, worn smooth.

entrance.name: Entrance Hall
entrance.description: A damp stone hall. Moss climbs the walls and water drips somewhere you cannot see. A brass lantern hangs from a hook by the stairs. Passages lead north and east.

storeroom.name: Storeroom
storeroom.description: Broken crates and the smell of old grain. Something glints between the boards: a copper coin. The only way out is back west.

corridor.name: Long Corridor
corridor.description: A long corridor of fitted stone. To the north the passage opens into utter darkness; a cold draft comes from it. From the west you hear slow, heavy breathing and the clink of a chain. South leads back to the hall.

dark_passage.name: Dark Passage
dark_passage.description: Your light pushes the darkness back a few paces. The floor is uneven and broken; without the lantern you would never have seen the pit yawning to your left. The passage continues north. South is the corridor.
dark_passage.death: You step into the darkness. The floor is not where your foot expects it to be. You fall for a long time.

troll_bridge.name: Troll Bridge
troll_bridge.description: A rope bridge over a black chasm, and on it a troll the size of a cart, holding out a hand the size of a shovel. Beyond him, east, a doorway. The corridor is back east.

hazard.pass: The troll weighs the coin, grunts, and steps aside.
hazard.death: The troll does not take promises. He takes you.

armory.name: Old Armory
armory.description: Racks of rusted weapons too brittle to lift. Dust and nothing else. The bridge is back south.

riddle_room.name: Carved Antechamber
riddle_room.description: A small round room. To the east, a stone door carved with a mouth and two ears, and words cut above it. South is the dark passage you came from.

east.riddle: I speak without a mouth and hear without ears. I have no body, but I come alive with the wind. What am I?
east.closed: The carved mouth speaks: a riddle, and the door does not move.
east.opened: The carved mouth closes. The door swings inward.

treasury.name: Treasury
treasury.description: A low vault and, in its centre, a chest.
